methodology: Django/React Web App Deployment on Ubuntu VPS (nginx + gunicorn + Postgres + Redis)

steps.detail: built SPA + backend source + requirements + .env; NEVER .venv/node_modules/.git/logs (heavy, and deps rebuild fresh)
dedicated Postgres user/db; password generated ON the server (openssl rand -hex 16), stored mode-600 root-only, written into .env — never printed
DEBUG=False, ALLOWED_HOSTS=<ip/domain>, CORS_ORIGINS=<origin>, DB to local postgres
root=SPA build; /api/ + /admin/ proxy to gunicorn with real Host/X-Forwarded-For; /static-django/ alias to collectstatic output; SPA fallback try_files

missing packages surface at migrate (dj_db_conn_pool not in requirements — install AND append to requirements); logs/ dir must pre-exist or logging config fails; Redis required by app (500 traced to it)
localhost 400s are ALLOWED_HOSTS, not breakage — always verify via the public IP/domain through nginx
